text:
Maya L.: hey team — heads up i had a minor wrist fracture over the weekend. ortho said limited typing and no heavy lifting for 3 weeks. wanted to flag before planning next sprint tasks.
Alex P.: ouch, hope you're okay. when's your appointment and is there a note you can attach for HR?
Maya L.: saw ortho this morning. surgery not needed, just a splint and rest. she wrote a short note: avoid long keyboard sessions for 3 weeks, can do meetings and code review with voice dictation. will upload.
Riley (people-ops): we can set up a short-term accommodation. options are: temporary keyboard-free duties, on-call relief for rotations overlapping the first 3 weeks, voice-to-text tooling, and pair-programming with screen-share. please fill the accommodation intake form so we have formal paperwork: https://internal.company/hr/accom-form
Maya L.: will fill it now. quick Q — will this affect my performance review in the cycle happening midmonth?
Devon (manager): short answer: no punitive impact. we'll adjust objectives for the accommodation period and note the temporary scope change. submit the form so people-ops can document it.
Devon (manager): i can reassign the heavy load tasks and take your deploy windows for the next 3 on-call rotations. anyone able to cover on-call nights?
Alex P.: i can cover two rotations next week. also happy to break up your large PRs into reviewer-friendly chunks.
people-ops-bot: New accommodation intake received from Maya L. — intake-id 20260410-1113. People Ops will follow up within 48 hours. (automated)
Riley (people-ops): thanks alex & devon. maya, after intake we'll create an accommodation memo for you & your manager only. legal note: medical docs go to HR only; managers get only accommodation details, not medical specifics.
Legal-Bot: Reminder: ADA accommodations are confidential and protected. Document only the work adjustments and dates. No adverse action for seeking accommodation.
Maya L.: thanks everyone. i'll attach the orthopedic note to the intake form and mark which tasks are flexible. i can still do async reviews and pair on calls.
Devon (manager): i'll update the sprint board, tag Alex for the nights, and block maya from last-minute merges that require heavy typing. we'll have a 1-week check-in and then 3-week wrap.
Alex P.: updating the runbook for on-call handoff and adding voice-dictate setup notes.
Maya L.: appreciate it all :heart: will post once form submitted.
